title: Permissions Secondary Audit
matrixRule: For Contractor, Employee, Supervisor, and Manager, module access requires the user's team to have the module enabled and the user's hierarchy rank to meet the module minimum. Admin and super-admin roles are full-access roles and do not depend on the team matrix.

byRole.Contractor: No module access by rank. Legacy direct RLS has own-user policies, but normal app module gates should block access.
byRole.Employee: Own timesheets only: create, view, update own rows, entries, and job codes. No employee/team filters.
byRole.Supervisor: Own timesheets plus scoped team visibility when Approvals Level 3+ and absence secondary authorise_bookings_team is effective. Self-approval and out-of-team approval are denied.
byRole.Manager: Own timesheets plus Approvals-scoped team/all visibility from absence secondary permissions. Timesheet approval mutations run through scoped server APIs rather than broad manager UPDATE RLS.
byRole.Admin: Full access and unscoped report/admin behavior.

byRole.Contractor: Own van checks: create, view, update, and delete own drafts and related items/hours/photos.
byRole.Supervisor: Own write flow plus read-all visibility for van inspections, items, daily hours, and photos via effective_is_supervisor. Not granted manager write/delete paths.
byRole.Manager: Read all; create checks for users; update/delete draft checks and manage related items/hours/photos via is_manager_admin, with workshop-team carve-outs in RLS.
byRole.Admin: Full access. Admin/super-admin bypasses the matrix and manager carve-outs.

byRole.Contractor: Own plant checks: create, view, update, and delete own drafts and related records.
byRole.Supervisor: Own write flow plus read-all visibility for plant inspections, items, daily hours, and photos. Not granted manager write/delete paths.
byRole.Manager: Read all; create checks for users; update/delete draft checks and manage related items/hours/photos via is_manager_admin, with workshop-team carve-outs in RLS.
byRole.Admin: Full access. Admin/super-admin bypasses the matrix and manager carve-outs.

byRole.Contractor: Own HGV check workflow for authored checks.
byRole.Supervisor: Own write flow plus read-all visibility for HGV inspections, items, daily hours, and photos. Not granted manager write/delete paths.
byRole.Manager: Read all; update/delete draft checks and manage related items/hours/photos via is_manager_admin, with workshop-team carve-outs in RLS.
byRole.Admin: Full access. Admin/super-admin bypasses the matrix and manager carve-outs.

byRole.Contractor: Assigned document access: view/read/sign assigned project documents and record visitor signatures where exposed.
byRole.Supervisor: Assigned-document workflow only. Project management APIs and UI require RAMS Level 4.
byRole.Manager: Level 4 management: upload/update/delete docs, view all assignments, create/update assignments, and manage document types. Personal favourites remain available to any RAMS holder for their own rows.
byRole.Admin: Full management, plus admin override where policies distinguish admin.

byRole.Contractor: No module access by rank in the current live matrix. If granted, absence secondary maps Contractor to the Employee tier.
byRole.Employee: Default secondary: see own bookings and add/edit own bookings.
byRole.Supervisor: Default secondary: see all/team/own bookings; add/edit team bookings; view team work shifts; authorise team bookings. No allowance visibility, overview/reasons tabs, work-shift edit, own edit, or own authorise by default. May delete only future, non-approved/non-processed leave in edit scope; cannot delete past or taken leave to restore allowance.
byRole.Manager: Default secondary: see all/team/own bookings; add/edit team and own bookings; see team allowances; view/edit team work shifts; authorise team and own bookings. Manager-admin RLS also covers several archival/generation tables. May delete only future, non-approved/non-processed leave in edit scope; cannot delete past or taken leave to restore allowance.
byRole.Admin: All absence secondary permissions true by default, including all scopes, reasons, overview, work shifts, generation/closure/admin flows. Only full-access admins may delete past, approved, or processed leave when other protected-record rules allow.

byRole.Contractor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Supervisor: Level 3 operational access: overview, history, and maintenance record create/update. Settings/categories/recipients remain Level 4+.
byRole.Manager: Level 4 settings access: categories, recipients, retired asset restore UI, plus Level 3 operations.
byRole.Admin: Level 5 destructive/category administration plus full maintenance settings control.

byRole.Contractor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Supervisor: No module access by rank. Toolbox Talks is enforced at Level 4 (Manager+).
byRole.Manager: Level 4 management can create toolbox talks/reminders, manage recipients, and view Toolbox reports/export compliance data without a separate Reports module grant. Recipient self-service remains separate.
byRole.Admin: Full access. Strict admin notification audit tools remain admin-only.

modules.matrixGate: Manager+ and team-enabled; non-admin disabled by default

byRole.Contractor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Supervisor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Manager: Level 4 can view training people, qualifications, records, import history, and workbook notes when the team or a user override enables the module. Training mutations require Level 5.
byRole.Admin: Automatic Level 5 access with full training administration.

byRole.Contractor: Workshop task user flow where team-enabled: view/create workshop tasks, comments, task attachments, and attachment responses through module-based policies.
byRole.Employee: Same workshop task user flow as Contractor.
byRole.Supervisor: Same module-user workflow. Settings/template/category UI is hidden; template/category RLS remains manager-admin gated.
byRole.Manager: Module-user workflow plus manager-admin controls for categories, subcategories, templates, template versions/sections/fields, and manager comment/delete paths.
byRole.Admin: Full workshop and template administration.

byRole.Contractor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Supervisor: Approvals Level 3 access. Timesheet and absence authorisation follows effective absence secondary scope, normally TEAM; self-approval and out-of-team approval are denied.
byRole.Manager: Approvals page for timesheets and absences. Authorisation follows effective absence secondary permissions; TEAM and ALL are enforced consistently in APIs and timesheet RLS.
byRole.Admin: All non-self approval scopes through Level 5 plus effective ALL secondary permission.

byRole.Contractor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Supervisor: No Actions module access by rank. Employees/Supervisors may still create constrained defect actions from inspections; management remains Actions Level 4.
byRole.Manager: Actions Level 4 manages reminder_actions, legacy actions management, assignment directory, action settings, and fleet-inspection reminder generation.
byRole.Admin: Full action workflow control.

byRole.Contractor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Supervisor: No module access by rank in the live matrix. A delegated Reports Level 3 remains own-only and is not manager-like.
byRole.Manager: Can run reports. Reports Level 4 is team-scoped regardless of job role; Level 5 is global. Accounts Supervisor/Manager retains the explicit global override.
byRole.Admin: All report scopes and settings; admin tier bypasses report team scoping.

byRole.Contractor: Can create own suggestions and view own suggestion/update thread through general authenticated policies; no management view.
byRole.Supervisor: Manage suggestions: view all, update statuses/details, create/view suggestion updates.
byRole.Manager: Same module-level suggestion management as Supervisor.
byRole.Admin: Same plus full admin override.

byRole.Contractor: No editor access; can use normal Help/FAQ content.
byRole.Employee: No editor access; can use normal Help/FAQ content.
byRole.Supervisor: Manage FAQ categories and articles through module-based API/RLS.
byRole.Manager: Same FAQ editor management as Supervisor.
byRole.Admin: Same plus full admin override.

byRole.Contractor: Can submit error reports and view own reports/updates; no management view.
byRole.Supervisor: Manage all error reports: view/update reports and create/view report updates through module-based policies.
byRole.Manager: Same error-report management as Supervisor.
byRole.Admin: Same plus full admin override.

byRole.Contractor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Supervisor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Manager: Can access user admin if team-enabled. Can create/update users, but can only assign employee-class non-super roles; role creation is limited to employee roles and no new permission tiers. Role edit/delete UI is admin-only.
byRole.Admin: Full user, role, hierarchy, and team administration. Permission levels and the Permission Guide are managed in Admin Settings.

byRole.Contractor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Supervisor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Manager: No access by rank. A deliberately delegated Admin Settings Level 5 override grants full permission-administration authority (including further Level 5 delegation) under sensitive PIN and non-view-as rules; Admin/Super Admin job-role assignment remains separately constrained where role-assignment gates apply.
byRole.Admin: Full Admin Settings access for permission levels, Permission Guide, payroll rules, and timesheet exceptions. A sensitive access PIN is also required when enabled for this module.

byRole.Contractor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Supervisor: Level 3 fleet read/overview/history access. Asset create/edit/retire and settings require Level 4; category administration requires Level 5.
byRole.Manager: Level 4 asset management and settings, plus Level 3 read/overview. Category CRUD remains Level 5.
byRole.Admin: Level 5 category/destructive administration plus full fleet settings control.

byRole.Contractor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Supervisor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Manager: View/create/update customers through module-based policies. Customer delete is admin-only.
byRole.Admin: Full customer access including admin-only delete.

byRole.Contractor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Supervisor: No module access by rank.
byRole.Manager: Create, view, update quote records, sequences, line items, workflow data where module-based. Quote/customer top-level deletes are admin-only; some legacy quote workflow tables still use is_manager_admin policies.
byRole.Admin: Full quote access including admin-only delete paths.

byRole.Contractor: Employee inventory view: set/change own location, view assigned/location inventory, request locations, and move/claim items through scoped module endpoints. Manager catalogue/group tables require Level 4.
byRole.Supervisor: Employee inventory workflows plus Supervisor site-assignment management where configured. Manager catalogue/group tables require Level 4.
byRole.Manager: Level 4 inventory manager view: items, locations, categories, groups, check intervals/history, location requests, minor-plant move/restore flows. Some delete paths are admin-only.
byRole.Admin: Full inventory manager/admin access, including admin-only delete paths.

byRole.Contractor: Universal Reminders access for assigned reminders. No reminder-action creation or assignment management.
byRole.Supervisor: Same assigned-reminder workflow. No Actions module by rank in the live matrix, so cannot create/update reminder_actions or assign reminders.
byRole.Manager: Assigned-reminder workflow plus Actions-based manager creation/update/assignment of reminder actions and workflow settings.
byRole.Admin: Full reminder/action workflow control.

modules.matrixGate: Admin automatic; non-admin disabled by default; explicit Level 2+ or team grants may be enabled later

byRole.Contractor: No default access during the initial rollout. A future explicit Level 2+ grant permits the employee-facing view of own published allocations.
byRole.Employee: No default access during the initial rollout. A future Level 2 grant permits the employee-facing view of own published allocations.
byRole.Supervisor: No default access during the initial rollout. A future Level 3 grant permits the employee-facing view of own published allocations; manager-board operations still require Level 4.
byRole.Manager: No default access during the initial rollout. A future explicit Level 4 grant permits scoped labour and plant allocation management for the manager's team/reporting lines.
byRole.Admin: Automatic Level 5 access, including global allocation management and publication, independent of team defaults.

prdRelevantMismatches: Intentional: Workshop team members receive fleet-wide inspection read visibility with constrained write paths; this override does not apply outside inspection modules.
Intentional: Accounts Supervisor/Manager retain global timesheet and report visibility override beyond normal team scope.
Intentional: Reminders are universal for assigned personal work, while reminder-action creation/assignment remains Actions Level 4.
